Sam (People Ops): Quick heads-up for anyone planning family growth this year 1 new guidance + pilot clarifications going live May 1. Please read; TL;DR and links below. 

Sam (People Ops): Whats changing (high level):
- Adoption & foster-care finalization: expanded top-up for placement/finalization leave + a $2,000 one-time travel reimbursement for eligible adoption/foster placement flights when domestic/international travel is required (pilot: US/UK/CAN only).
- Fertility & family-building: increased fertility benefit annual allowance from $5,000 to $8,000 during the pilot period (global, subject to local restrictions).
- Comp-time interaction: adoption travel days and placement support are eligible for either comp-time accrual or PTO use, not both; choose at request time.

hr-bot: Policy page updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/family-building-2026 (version 2026-05-01). Filing link: https://redwood.internal/hr/leave-requests

Ana B.: Quick Q  will the $2k travel cover partner travel too? Were traveling with two adults and a toddler.

Sam (People Ops): It covers reasonable travel costs for the employee and one designated caregiver (partner/spouse). Receipts required; per diem rules apply. If travel is more expensive (e.g., extra child) we can review case-by-case. See "Travel Reimbursement, Adoption" section.

Jamal R.: If Im on 0.8 FTE, is fertility benefit pro-rated?

payroll-bot: Fertility benefit is pro-rated for part-time roles based on FTE at time of claim. See payroll FAQ: https://redwood.internal/hr/payroll-faqs

Sam (People Ops): Correct, pro-rating applies. The portal will show the available amount when you submit a claim.

Nora H.: How does the adoption top-up interact with statutory pay in the UK? We already have 39 weeks statutory SMP/MA.

legal-bot: In the UK, the pilot supplements statutory pay for the primary caregiver up to the top-up amount defined in the policy. Local law controls eligibility windows; see UK appendix. The policy defaults to local statutory requirements where they are more generous.

Sam (People Ops): For folks in EMEA/APAC not in the pilot countries, we still provide fertility benefit increases (subject to local regs) but travel reimbursement & adoption top-up pilot does not apply unless explicitly listed.

Ana B.: Can I stack the $2k travel reimbursement with existing travel policy per-diem? Or is it an either/or?

Sam (People Ops): The $2k is specifically for adoption/foster placement travel and is separate from regular business travel per-diem. Personal travel receipts should be filed under the adoption claim form. Business travel policy does not cover family-placement flights.

Jamal R.: How do we request comp-time vs PTO for placement days? Want to make sure manager approves ahead of time.

Sam (People Ops): When you submit a leave/claim in the HR portal, theres a dropdown: "Use PTO" or "Accrue Comp-time". Manager approval required for comp-time scheduling. Example Slack command for quick request: `/hr leave request --type adoption --start 2026-06-14 --days 5 --pay top-up --travel-claim yes`

hr-bot: After approval, payroll-bot will apply top-up payments on the following payroll cycle. Travel reimbursements process within 30 days after receipts upload.

payroll-bot: Reminder: travel reimbursement claims submitted without itemized receipts will be denied. Upload via HR portal -> Claims -> Adoption Travel. Exchange rate conversions handled at date of claim.

Nora H.: Is the fertility benefit increase taxable?

legal-bot: Tax treatment depends on country. In the US the benefit is taxable income; in some countries it may be tax-free. The claim form will show estimated tax withholding when relevant.

Sam (People Ops): Pilot metrics: uptake, average claim size, time-to-reimbursement, and manager feedback. Pilot review scheduled Nov 15. If you want to be part of a focus group, ping me. Office hours tomorrow 11am PT in #people-ops-office-hours. :seedling:

Ana B.: Thanks Sam  appreciate the clarity. Pinged you about a private case.

Sam (People Ops): Got it, will follow up. Thanks everyone! :heart:
